prediction.kind: descriptive, no bars: nothing is scored against a threshold except the code checks, which are arithmetic, not predictions
prediction.by: user, 2026-11-17 chat: run 1 is the agreed calibration, with gaps and their spread, no bars
prediction.reported: per item (the rebuilt item and the 40 fine-tunes) and reading (1 neurons and heads; 2 heads and MLP blocks; 3 per-site least-squares map from M's unit activations): S = 1 - KL(F || H) / KL(F || M), KL(F || M), KL(F || H), H's max relative logit error against F, and each site's local fit residual. Per pair, reading and seed: S of the reuse member minus S of its twin. Per pair and reading: those gaps' values by seed, min, max and sample sd over the seeds read. The three readings are three different targets and are never averaged or combined
prediction.side_number: for items whose embedding, unembedding or final norm differ from M's (the parity twin and the memorised fact, full states): S with F's values there; no gap, comparison or summary reads it
prediction.edge_cases: KL(F || M) at or under kl_floor: S is null ('no change'), with KL(F || H) beside it as that reading's floor. A pair-seed with either member missing or null gives no gap (left out of by_seed). sd is null under 2 seeds. S may be negative (H further from F than M is) or above 1 never (KL >= 0); it is reported as computed. A site whose F write is zero on every fit position has residual NaN. An F unit that writes zero is left out of the pairing (its M partner gets gain 0); an M unit that writes zero gets gain 0 if paired

pairs.source: E196's PAIRS (experiments/rule_retention_pairs/run.py), each (reuse member, twin); stage n of run.py is pair n - 1
pairs.states: seeds 0 and 1: E196's (old_tasks.TASKS[name].states, delta-W of the 24 matrices; twin and fact full states built_control_sum amend1_control_s*.pt and memorised_fact fact_s*.pt). Seeds 2 and 3: E192's experiments/curve_test/results/large/<item>.pt (checked 2026-11-17: all 20 present, all 'learned' in curve_test/results/train.json; twin and fact are full state dicts of 35 tensors, the 8 old-task sides delta-W of the 24 matrices, fp32 for copy24, cipher24, ident32, rand32 and bf16 for case and repeat)

do_nothing.build: F is a copy of M
do_nothing.reading_1_planted: every neuron and head paired with itself at gain 1
do_nothing.reported: S null ('no change') in every reading; KL(F || H) is each reading's own floor

gains_unit.build: every neuron (input row and output column) and every head (q, k, v rows and o_proj columns) of M shuffled within its layer, each output times a gain of random sign and size uniform in [gain_lo, gain_hi] (seed check_seed)
gains_unit.reading_1_planted: the shuffle undone (F's unit i paired with M's unit perm[i]) and each gain recovered within gain_tol
gains_unit.reported: reading 2's S, expected below 1, not checked

gains_block.build: M with each layer's down_proj times one gain and each head's o_proj columns times one gain, signs random, sizes uniform in [gain_lo, gain_hi] (seed check_seed + 1)
gains_block.reading_1_planted: identity pairing; every neuron of layer l at the block's gain, each head at its gain, within gain_tol
gains_block.reported: S = 1 in every reading follows from H reproducing F

circuit_off.build: E195's circuit C (layer 1, the 8 neurons of 'C') switched off: their down_proj columns zeroed
circuit_off.reading_1_planted: C's F units write zero and are left out (partner -1); every other unit paired with itself at gain 1 within gain_tol; so M's C units hold gain 0
circuit_off.reported: reading 2's S, expected below 1, not checked

code_checks.rule: a check holds when: KL(F || M) is above kl_floor exactly when kl_FM_above_floor; for each reading in H_reproduces_F, H's max relative logit error against F (every position of the 512 read windows, max over windows of max |H - F| / max |F|) is at most logit_tol; reading 1's pairing equals the planted one at every site and each paired unit's gain is within gain_tol of its planted gain. Any miss: exit 1 with results/stage0.json holding 'stopped', before any other item

expected_at_F_equals_M.KL(F || H), readings 1 and 2: 0 within rounding: every unit paired with itself at gain 1, H is M
expected_at_F_equals_M.KL(F || H), reading 3: 0 within rounding: the least-squares map is W_M on the span of M's activations
expected_at_F_equals_M.gap reuse minus twin: not defined (both null); a pair of identical members reads 0

measures.fit windows: a seeded subset (torch.randperm, seed fit_seed) of n_fit windows of the item's fit half as E173 and E184 built it (old_tasks.task_windows for the old tasks, variable_read.xor2_windows for twin and fact; stages 0 and 1 copy24's), every one of the 8 positions
measures.read windows: E196's subset: n_read windows of the item's read half (torch.randperm, seed read_seed), the last position for KL, every position for the logit error
measures.second moments: per site, fp64 sums over every fit position of a^F' a^F, a^F' a^M and a^M' a^M, where a is the site's unit activations (MLP: the 3,072 neuron activations; attention: the six heads' outputs before o_proj) of each network's own units on M's input to that layer
measures.H: M with down_proj and o_proj of each layer replaced by the reading's matrix (commute.held_model docstring); run end to end by its own forward, fp32, TF32 off; embedding, unembedding and final norm M's
measures.gap check: seeds 0 and 1: mean TV between F and M at the last position over the whole read half within reload_tol of E184's recorded gap (a check that F and its windows are E184's); seeds 2 and 3 have no recorded gap, so it is logged only

noise_floor.logit error: E195 and E196 rebuilt F unit by unit in fp32 and read a hybrid gate of 0 against the same 1e-3 tolerance (experiments/rule_retention_pairs/results/run_pair1.log). H here is a plain forward with fp32 weights cast from fp64 fits, so its rounding is a cast of each output matrix (relative ~6e-8 per weight); reading 3's pseudo-inverse rounding was never measured: the do-nothing check measures each reading's floor before any item
noise_floor.S across seeds: not measured for this reading; E196's level A reuse-minus-twin gap had a pooled sd over seeds 0 and 1 of about 1.4e-4 (experiments/rule_retention_pairs/results/summary.json), a different reading

blind_to.reading 1: a rule rebuilt as a mix of several M neurons
blind_to.reading 2: changes inside a block that keep the block's direction
blind_to.reading 3: any change that is linear in M's activations at a site
blind_to.all: a change in what a layer's input carries if F's units at every site are still gains of M's; anything outside the 512 read windows and the last position; embedding, unembedding and final-norm changes count as not surviving (the side number shows them)

positive_control: stage 0: gains-only and circuit-off must read S = 1 where arithmetic says so, on the same windows, code path and positions as the items; do-nothing reads 'no change'

threshold_sources.n_fit: the appendix: 16,384 fit-half windows, about 131,000 positions
threshold_sources.n_read, read_seed: the appendix: E196's 512 read windows and seed
threshold_sources.gain_lo, gain_hi: chosen by the code writer for the code checks only: sizes bounded away from 0 so every planted unit writes, random signs because the settled gain class allows any sign
threshold_sources.n_max, held_share: E173's Config, whose numbers build the twin and fact windows
threshold_sources.sum_batch: 512 windows per batch, as E196's profile_batch
